info.name: Extract
info.summary: Extract archive from the web interface
info.description:
Extract archives.
* **Supported :**
* Zip * Rar * Tar * Gzip * 7z * Deb * Bzip2 * Xz / tar.xz * Zstandard / tar.zst
* **Requirements :** * PHP zip extension for ZIP * p7zip / p7zip-full (7za) for 7z, TAR, XZ, GZIP, BZIP2 and DEB * PHP rar, unrar or full 7z for RAR * zstd or full 7z (24.01+) for Zstandard
* **Note :** Password-protected archives are not supported yet. Object storage and server-side encryption are supported: the archive is unpacked into a temporary directory and the result is imported through the Nextcloud filesystem.
info.author: Paul Lereverend
